purpose: Preflight identity memory for Aachu/Zuv face and clothes consistency before any image generation.

non_negotiable: thick dark curly hair with a visible curl silhouette
strong dark brows and dark almond eyes
defined nose and relaxed masculine face structure
short natural stubble, never clean-shaven and never a full beard
exactly about two inches taller than Aachu, never a dramatic height gap
clothing_and_detail_anchors: white or off-white zip top with grey trousers from portrait-07 when story-relevant
dark charcoal shirt from together-18 when story-relevant
simple chain or watch only when visibly supported by a selected reference

non_negotiable: large expressive dark eyes and softly arched brows
delicate nose, natural lips, youthful oval face, and soft cheeks
playful real-person expression, never a generic model face
exactly about two inches shorter than Zuv, never a petite-versus-towering contrast
clothing_and_detail_anchors: black layer or top with blue jeans from face-04 when story-relevant
grey pinstripe jacket with cream top from together-18 when story-relevant
small jewelry only when visibly supported by a selected reference

identity_contact_sheet_guidance.option_id_rule: Use the ID labels printed on identity-face-contact-sheet.jpg when discussing or replacing references.
identity_contact_sheet_guidance.aachu_repair_rule: If Anchal/Aachu face is wrong, stop generation, choose 2-4 stronger Aachu face IDs from the contact sheet, rebuild the package with those identity images, and regenerate from slide 1.
identity_contact_sheet_guidance.zuv_repair_rule: If Himanshu/Zuv face is wrong, stop generation, choose 1-2 stronger Zuv face IDs from the contact sheet, rebuild the package with those identity images, and regenerate from slide 1.
identity_contact_sheet_guidance.hard_limit: Do not accept a pretty scene or correct text as final when either face fails likeness.

hard_fails: Generation starts without loading the identity contact sheet.
Generation starts without loading the selected identity references.
Prompt only describes the faces in text but does not use actual identity images.
Generated Himanshu/Zuv loses his curly-hair silhouette, strong brows, almond eyes, defined nose, short natural stubble, or natural proportions.
Generated Aachu/Anchal loses her long thick wavy hair, expressive eyes, arched brows, youthful oval face, soft cheeks, or natural proportions.
The couple's real two-inch height difference becomes a dramatic height gap.
Wedding or engagement cues are copied from a reference: no rings, bangles, ceremonial clothing, kiss pose, or staged couple-portrait pose.
Carousel dots, UI, background vehicles, old reference text, or old reference brandmarks are copied into the illustration.
A slide is accepted because the scene is pretty even though the faces are wrong.
limitations: This dossier inventories the local identity library and creates visual preflight anchors; it cannot mathematically guarantee model output likeness.
Final acceptance still requires visual QA against the identity references before packaging a slide as final.
